source_kind.description: Where the record came from and whether it is suitable for formal publication.

formal_publication_rule: the record has a current market scope
policy, tax and access records have a current Simplified Chinese display translation
official, traceable and derived records have a source_url or source_record_id
uploaded records have a source_record_id, source_file or evidence_hash
industry_advisory_rule: source_kind is traceable and source_class is industry_advisory
the article has a specific source_url, published_at and collected_at
market_codes are populated only when the article explicitly identifies a market
verification_status remains pending unless a separate record-level review is performed
industry advisory records are visible as traceable reference material but are excluded from formal policy statistics, reports and automatic high-risk alerts

retention.raw_records: Retain pending, rejected and demo records for audit/reprocessing.
retention.scoped_records: Records matching the active market/platform/category scope.
retention.formal_records: Only records passing the formal publication rule.
